Bill.BriefDescription: Providing for membership in school directors' associations to be voluntary.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to school directors' associations; amending RCW28A.345.020; providing an effective date; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 28A.345.020 and 1969 ex.s. c 223 s 28A.61.020 are eachamended to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Until December 31, 2005, the membership of the schooldirectors' association shall comprise the members of the boards ofdirectors of the school districts of the state. School boards ofdirectors that intend to resign from the association under subsection(2) of this section must provide the association with at least fivemonths' prior written notice of that intent. (2) Beginning on January 1, 2006, membership in the schooldirectors' association shall be voluntary for school district boards ofdirectors.

This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of the p. 1 SHB 1115state government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectJuly 1, 2005.
